# The Rooiberg Wander

> An all-inclusive 3-night / 3-day point-to-point walking safari on foot through 15,000 hectares
> of malaria-free Big 5 mountain wilderness near Rooiberg, Limpopo, South Africa (the Waterberg),
> about 2.5 hours from OR Tambo International Airport. Tagline: "A luxury walking safari in the
> Waterberg".

## Key facts

- Format: an all-inclusive, point-to-point walking expedition with private trail guides,
  connecting three private safari lodges. You walk while your luggage and provisions are moved
  ahead between lodges each day. Every meal is included, served family-style around the boma fire
  with selected South African estate wines and local beers.
- Duration: 3 nights / 3 days. No walking on the arrival day (Day 1); depart immediately after
  the final walk on Day 4.
- Walking: three days of 15 to 20 km each, about 55 km in total.
- Terrain: the Groenkop and Elandsberg mountains, with deep kloofs, riverbeds and open savanna
  plains. Grading: moderate to challenging; a good level of hiking fitness is required.
- Malaria: 100% malaria-free.
- Group: 2 to 8 guests per departure, with two trail guides. The first booking on a date opens
  it, from 2 guests; once a date has 2 guests it is a guaranteed departure and later bookings
  join in 2s or more until the 8 places are taken. Booking all 8 places gives a group sole
  exclusive use of the trail and each safari lodge overnight.
- Start days: departures run Sunday, Monday, Thursday and Friday until 31 December 2028, while
  guiding capacity is built up. Every weekday opens from 1 January 2029.
- Safety: the Two-Man Rule. Two experienced trail guides accompany you at all times.
- Wildlife: a Big 5 reserve with more than 66 mammal species (lion, leopard, elephant, buffalo,
  cheetah, giraffe, plus wide-ranging plains game) and over 168 recorded bird species.
- Safari lodges (characterful, established private bush lodges, each with a swimming pool, safe
  drinking water and free WiFi): Temminck's Lodge (valley basecamp, start & end), Oukraal (bush
  lodge, Night 2), Blackwood (mountain lodge, Night 3).
- Route: begins and ends at Temminck's Lodge. Over Groenkop to Oukraal (Day 2); up the high
  ridges via L-Kloof to Blackwood by way of the Welgedacht lookout, with views over Marakele
  (Day 3); across the plains along the Sand River back to Temminck's Lodge (Day 4).
- Price: per person sharing, for the whole 3-night trail, VAT and conservation levies included.
  R15,900 per person in high season and R12,720 in low season for 2027 start dates; R17,172 and
  R13,737 for 2028. High season is 1 April to 31 October, plus 15 December to 15 January. A booking
  made 8 to 21 days before arrival gets a further 22% discount. Includes
  accommodation, all meals with selected South African wines and beers, two experienced trail
  guides, daily baggage transport, all conservation levies and VAT. Excludes travel to and from
  Temminck's Lodge, personal travel insurance and gratuities.
- Payment: full payment is due 45 days before arrival and is non-refundable thereafter. Bookings
  made 45 or more days out pay a 50% deposit now, with the balance due at the 45-day mark.
- Booking window: online bookings are accepted for start dates from 1 April 2027, up to 24 months
  ahead. The trail is currently in
  beta testing; dates before 1 April 2027 are available to family and friends by enquiry or
  WhatsApp only, at a discount.
- Contact: Hanlie, WhatsApp +27 82 905 8832, office hours 08h00 to 17h00.

## Location

Near Rooiberg, Limpopo, South Africa, in the Waterberg region close to Marakele. About 2.5 hours
from OR Tambo International Airport.
